concept.title: Relics of the Turquoise Cove
concept.logline: On sunlit, serene Mordunholm, you scour every corner to recover the lantern cores and restore the Parrot Peak.
concept.source_prompt: Tropical Cove. tropical beach cove lagoon collectathon Relic hunt
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Coral Landing and becomes the one who brings the Parrot Peak back to life.

key_locations.name: Coral Landing
key_locations.description: The start: Coral Landing, where every trail of the archipelago hop begins.

key_locations.name: Broken Pier
key_locations.description: Broken Pier: a dock on the way out from Coral Landing.

key_locations.name: Castaway Camp
key_locations.description: Castaway Camp: a camp on the way out from Coral Landing.

key_locations.name: Sunken Ruins
key_locations.description: Sunken Ruins: a ruin on the way out from Coral Landing.

key_locations.name: Coral Arch
key_locations.description: Coral Arch: a landmark on the way out from Coral Landing.

key_locations.name: Parrot Peak
key_locations.description: Parrot Peak: the far end of the archipelago hop, where the story ends.

characters.name: Keeper Nadia
characters.description: Waits in Coral Landing and knows why the Parrot Peak fell silent.

characters.name: Wren the Deckhand
characters.description: Follows you from Coral Landing and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Reef Stalker
characters.description: A reef stalker that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Sefa the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Mordunholm for anything shiny.

characters.name: Sand Piper
characters.description: A harmless sand piper that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Find every relic, in any order
Bonus: make offerings at the sites
hazards: Reef Stalker hunting near its lair

actions.value: On sunlit, serene Mordunholm, you scour every corner to recover the lantern cores and restore the Parrot Peak.
5 relics are scattered across Relics of the Turquoise Cove. Find them all, in any order.
Relic secured: the Broken Pier Gem.
Relic secured: the Castaway Camp Gem.
Relic secured: the Sunken Ruins Gem.
Relic secured: the Coral Arch Gem.
Relic secured: the Parrot Peak Gem.
Every relic is home. The hunt is over.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Nadia
nodes.text: So you've come to Coral Landing at last. I am Keeper Nadia. On sunlit, serene Mordunholm, you scour every corner to recover the lantern cores and restore the Parrot Peak.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Keeper Nadia
nodes.text: Back again. Coral Landing is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Nadia
nodes.text: Go to Broken Pier, then Castaway Camp. Whatever still remembers Relics of the Turquoise Cove is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Nadia
nodes.text: They say Coral Landing was built on what was left of an older place. Cheerful, even then. Ask the stones and they won't argue.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Nadia
nodes.text: Broken Pier: Broken Pier: a dock on the way out from Coral Landing.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Nadia
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Relics of the Turquoise Cove back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Nadia
nodes.text: Castaway Camp: Castaway Camp: a camp on the way out from Coral Landing.

nodes.speaker: Wren the Deckhand
nodes.text: Wren the Deckhand circles your feet, then looks toward Castaway Camp as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Wren the Deckhand
nodes.text: Wren the Deckhand hums quietly, the way it does before the weather turns.

nodes.speaker: Wren the Deckhand
nodes.text: It turns toward Castaway Camp. Castaway Camp: a camp on the way out from Coral Landing.

nodes.speaker: Reef Stalker
nodes.text: The reef stalker watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Sefa the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Coral Landing. Sefa the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Sefa the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Relics of the Turquoise Cove that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Sefa the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Coral Arch after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Sand Piper
nodes.text: The sand piper freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
